read.thesis: Prologis guides 2026 development starts of $4-5B (about 40% data centres) after $3.1B in 2025, with U.S. vacancy at 7.4% and expected to ease to 7.1-7.2% as absorption nears 200M sq ft against 180-185M deliveries.

utilisation.quote: moving occupancy to 95.8% at period end and averaging 95.3% for the quarter

capex.quote: we expect 40% of that roughly to be in data center

triggers.label: US deliveries fall to 180-185M sq ft
triggers.quote: Deliveries are on pace to be 185 million, 180 million square feet in 2026, down from 200 million square feet last

triggers.label: Net effective rent change 44% in Q4
triggers.quote: Net effective rent change was 44% for the quarter

triggers.label: Q4 US net absorption 59M sq ft
triggers.quote: Fourth quarter net absorption was 59 million square feet in the U.S.

triggers.label: Mark-to-market falls to high-30s/~40%
triggers.quote: you can unpack and infer by looking through the supplemental will be in the high 30s. Or roughly 40% in 2026

guidance.quote: Net effective same-store growth is forecasted to be in a range of 4.25% to 5.25%

guidance.metric: Core FFO incl. net promote per share
guidance.quote: Core FFO, including net promote expense, will range between $6 and $6.2 per share
we are forecasting development starts to range between $4 billion and $5 billion
We are forecasting average occupancy to range between 94.75% and 95.75%
Acquisitions will range between $1 billion and $1.5 billion

red_flags.label: Mark-to-market normalising from 50% to high-30s/40%
red_flags.quote: Management clarified that mark-to-market rent change is forecasted to normalize, with an expected high-30% to roughly 40% mark in 2026, compared with 50% in 2025.

evasions.topic: Data center fund structure and timing
evasions.quote: We expect to know more in the coming weeks and months.
